journals.name: Scientometrics

metrics.transparencyData: Data Availability Statement required for original research

notFor: field literature reviews without scientometric contribution
descriptive keyword mapping without methodological justification

journals.name: Political Science Research and Methods

metrics.transparencyData: replication data and code required after acceptance

notFor: method-heavy manuscripts without clear political science contribution
empirical claims without reproducible data and code

journals.name: Perspectives on Politics
bestFor: high-end research for general political science readers

metrics.transparencyData: data and log files expected for quantitative inference before publication

notFor: narrow subfield manuscripts without broader political science significance
public commentary without scholarly evidence and theoretical contribution
technical papers that do not translate findings for broad political science readers

journals.name: The China Quarterly
bestFor: research reports based on empirical evidence
China-focused social science with strong contextual knowledge

metrics.sjrHIndex: SJR known; H-index verify via SCImago
metrics.transparencyData: context-dependent; explain data, interviews, archives, and evidence-sharing limits

notFor: generic China case studies without China studies engagement
policy commentary without original research and analytical argument
manuscripts that ignore pinyin, Chinese characters, citation, and table/figure style requirements
